text.tspan: Every heading in the document, foldable — the
quiet stretches collapse so a long draft fits
on one screen. Click any row to jump; the
search box above filters it by verbatim text,
🔍 collapses distant text so you see the map; 📄
renders a normal scrolling window around your
focus instead. Toggle any time — it's just how
this pane reads, not a different draft.
The block you're pointed at, expanded in full
with its immediate neighbours. This is what a
change request from the panel on the right
acts on by default — navigate to a paragraph
📌 pins a paragraph as reading context for the
writer without making it the thing being
changed — "read this while you work." Pin as
many as you like; unpin all clears them.
Describe the change in your own words and send
it. It works on your pinned paragraphs as
context and the current focus as the target —
mark, describe, send is the whole workflow.
